group.listening: On. Pressing a channel key on this keyboard moves the rest of the group with it. To switch back with one press, run MX Unison on the other computer too.
scroll.title: Scroll speed
scroll.help: Changes the scroll factor for this mouse on this computer. Your touchpad is unaffected.
popup.smartshiftHelp: Ratchets when you scroll slowly, spins freely when you scroll fast.
popup.fnHelp: When on, F1–F12 act as media keys; hold Fn for F-keys.
group.followOff: Off. Turn on to make the rest of the group move whenever you press a channel key on this keyboard.
group.computersHelp: Move every device in the group to one computer at once. Mice switch first and the keyboard last. Each device must already be paired with that computer.
group.empty: Turn on the devices below that should move together. Your computers then appear here, named from the devices.
group.unavailable: A device in the group is not paired with this computer.
group.devicesHelp: Channels are matched to computers by the names stored on each device. Changes save automatically.
group.memberOffline: Not connected. Connect it to add it to the group.
group.mismatch: The channel names on %1 suggest a different mapping.
group.customizeHelp: Pick which channel each device uses for each computer. Use this when a device has no stored names, or names that differ. Channel numbers can differ between devices.
device.help: Moves just this device. The rest of the group stays put.
device.none: This device does not expose Easy Switch controls.
device.renameHelp: Names are stored on the device and show on every computer. Solaar may keep the active channel set to this computer’s hostname.
device.groupedHelp: Moves only this device. It is in the desk group, so you usually switch from Desk instead.
desk.getStarted: connect a mouse or keyboard to get started
desk.pickDevice: Pick a device to change its settings.
page.moreHelp: Other settings this device reports. Most people never need these.
actions.help: Click a control to change what it does. Software actions send a shortcut to the focused app, or run gestures when you hold the button and move.
actions.none: This device does not expose configurable buttons or keys.
actions.forHelp: Save an action for All apps first; you can then add app overrides.
actions.appHelp: Pick a running app, or type its Hyprland class and press Enter.
actions.stepsHelp: One shortcut per line, up to 8, sent in order. Record adds the next chord you press.
actions.gestureHelp: Hold the button and move. Gestures run on release; a small movement counts as a click. Leave a direction empty to do nothing.
actions.removeAllHelp: Also removes this control's app overrides
actions.hardwareHelp: Hardware remaps apply in every app and on every computer. Solaar rule handling is for external Solaar rules; leave it Regular when using a software action.
actions.ruleHelp: Regular unless you use your own Solaar rules for this control.
